summary: Fury Gold Mines Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for gold, silver, lithium, and rare earth elements deposits. The company was formerly known as Auryn Resources Inc. and changed its name to Fury Gold Mines Limited in October 2020. Fury Gold Mines Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Toronto, Canada.
